push.title: L 1-4 vs Abdina fc | You: 8.0 (first match performance)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, an 8.0 against Abdina fc, your first match performance. That's a keeper.

THE GOOD
+ 5 key passes. Somebody's gonna owe you dinner for those passes.
+ That connection with BellyTb1 is gold. Don't let it rust.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (17 vs their best 8). That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ 4 goals conceded: +0.1. Do that again.

THE BAD
- No shots. Key note: Ask for it early in the half-space, where a first-time finish is on.
- Pass accuracy: 77%. Next target: 88%+.
- 1-4 to Abdina fc. A lesson wrapped in a loss.

Skills corner: Live on the last defender's shoulder and time the run as the passer lifts their head.

PhogsToffees, one more thing before you log off: Believe in yourself the way your dog believes in you.

You make this job too easy. Don't tell the gaffer. - Coach Lasso

players.name: BellyTb1

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: You were everywhere. Teammates looked for you because they trust you.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

weaknesses.detail: 7/15 passes (47%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

weaknesses.detail: 15 passes but no key passes - plenty of the ball, little going forward
weaknesses.title: Playing forward
tips: Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.
Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.
Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from.
weaknesses.coach: Plenty of the ball, but not much going forward. Let's hurt 'em with it.

push.title: L 1-4 vs Abdina fc | You: 7.8 (first match performance)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.8 against Abdina fc. You're on the right road. Let's find the passing lane.

THE GOOD
+ 15 passes. You were more involved than a church bake-sale committee.
+ A goal against Abdina fc. You treated that chance like a winning lottery ticket and cashed it.
+ 2 tackles won gave you a +0.5 lift. Nice little tailwind.

THE BAD
- No key passes from 15 passes. Let's try: Receive on the half-turn so your first touch can go forward. Small fix, big smile.
- 4 goals conceded cost 0.1. Squeaky wheel; let's oil it.
- 1-4 to Abdina fc. Bruised, not broken.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 47% (7 of 15). I love you, but that wasn't football. That was a fire drill. Fix it like this: Weight matters as much as direction. Firm along the ground beats soft and loopy.

Practice pointer: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.

BellyTb1, something I want you to sleep on: Fall seven times, stand up eight, then ask for the ball.

You've got more in you. I've seen it. - Coach Lasso
